parole.significato: Commiphora gen. et spp., syns. Balsamodendron, Balsamea
parole.testo: The form بَشَام (bašām) belongs to the root ب ش م (b š m) with meanings related to indigestion, nausea, disgust. Via the idea of luxury, abundance, and indulgence; to overeat, over-indulge, to be surfeit, this compares to the contronymic significance of the root associated with Arabic طَلْح (ṭalḥ, “
